"""laap-daemon 完整闭环测试：启动 → 持久化 → 重启恢复 → 停止。"""
import sys, os, time, json, threading

os.chdir(r"D:\LAAP")
sys.path.insert(0, r"D:\LAAP")

from laap.daemon.config import DaemonConfig
from laap.daemon.runner import LaapDaemon, daemon_status

PORT = 19422
STATE = r"D:\LAAP\laap\daemon\state"

def wait_http(url, timeout=10):
    import urllib.request
    t0 = time.time()
    while time.time() - t0 < timeout:
        try:
            resp = urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=2)
            return json.loads(resp.read().decode())
        except Exception:
            time.sleep(0.5)
    return None

def start_daemon(port):
    cfg = DaemonConfig(daemon_port=port)
    d = LaapDaemon(cfg)
    t = threading.Thread(target=d.start, daemon=True)
    t.start()
    time.sleep(2)
    return d

print("=== Phase 1: 首次启动 ===")
d1 = start_daemon(PORT)
s = wait_http(f"http://127.0.0.1:{PORT}/status")
print(f"  Status: {s['status']} | Cache ready: {s['cache_ready']}")

# 写入测试缓存
print("\n=== Phase 2: 写入缓存 ===")
sys.path.insert(0, r"D:\LAAP\aris_brain")
from aether_llm_gateway import L0Cache
from aether_semantic_cache import SemanticCache

# 通过 daemon 的缓存实例写入
if d1._l0:
    from aether_llm_gateway import ChatResponse
    msgs = [{"role": "system", "content": "sys"}, {"role": "user", "content": "这是什么"}]
    d1._l0.set(msgs, ChatResponse(content="这是测试"))
    print("  L0 写入 1 条")
if d1._l1:
    d1._l1.set(msgs, ChatResponse(content="这是测试"))
    print("  L1 写入 1 条")

# 手动保存
d1._save_cache()
print("  缓存已保存到磁盘")

# 停止
d1.stop()
time.sleep(1)
print("\n=== Phase 3: 停止 ===")
print(f"  After stop: {daemon_status()['status']}")

# 检查文件存在
l0_path = DaemonConfig().l0_cache_path
l1_path = DaemonConfig().l1_cache_path
print(f"  L0 文件存在: {os.path.exists(l0_path)}")
print(f"  L1 文件存在: {os.path.exists(l1_path)}")

print("\n=== Phase 4: 重启恢复 ===")
d2 = start_daemon(PORT)
s2 = wait_http(f"http://127.0.0.1:{PORT}/status")
print(f"  Status: {s2['status']} | Cache ready: {s2['cache_ready']}")

# 验证缓存已恢复
print(f"  L0 恢复条目: {len(d2._l0._data) if d2._l0 else 'N/A'}")
print(f"  L1 恢复条目: {len(d2._l1._entries) if d2._l1 else 'N/A'}")

# 验证能命中
if d2._l0:
    hit = d2._l0.get([{"role": "system", "content": "sys"}, {"role": "user", "content": "这是什么"}])
    print(f"  L0 命中: {hit is not None}")

d2.stop()
time.sleep(1)
print("\n=== Daemon 完整闭环 PASSED ===")
